data_description.device_name: Friendly name used for the device and entity display names in Home Assistant.
data_description.device_url: Local URL or IP address of the ERV (e.g. http://192.168.1.100)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Check the URL and ensure the ERV is online.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll the device for state updates.
data_description.retry_count: Number of times to retry a failed read or write before reporting an error.
data_description.verify_delay: Seconds to wait after sending a command before re-polling to verify it took effect.
data_description.boost_recovery: Automatically resend boost and speed commands if the device state drifts from what Home Assistant last set (e.g. boost expiry after ~1 hour, or an unexpected power cycle).
data_description.cfm_alert_threshold: How far the measured CFM must deviate from the configured target before the mismatch timer starts (5–30 CFM). Recommended: 10.
data_description.cfm_alert_duration: How long the deviation must persist before the mismatch sensor fires (30–300 seconds). Allows the ERV time to recover from transient upsets before alarming. Recommended: 60.
